'''Record racing''' was a tactic used by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]] to stay one step ahead of [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agencies]]. The method involved staying ahead of updates to [[Transponder code/Legends|transponder code]] logs disseminated by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], [[Sector Ranger/Legends|Sector Rangers]], and the [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Office of Customs]]. Because updates took time to distribute, crimes committed in once region of space would not become known for a period of time to forces operating elsewhere. Records took [[Standard day/Legends|days]] to update between [[Star system/Legends|star systems]], [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] between [[Sector/Legends|sectors]], and [[Standard month/Legends|months]] between regions. Fast ships constantly on the move could stay ahead of transponder code updates for a long time.<ref name="PP" />
